bead.title: bench-pr-A1: harbor-runner Docker image + shell harness/task adapters + runtime-probe + CONTRACTs
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The Go runner forces host Python by putting the repo root on Harbor's PYTHONPATH so Harbor can import scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.*. We want the host to need only bash + Node + Docker. Harbor and its agent plugins must move into a container, and the matrix-side Python harness_adapters/ must be re-expressed as shell so the bash runner (A2/A3) can call them.

ROOT CAUSE: cmd/bench/matrix.go:1117-1129 prepends opts.repoRoot to PYTHONPATH so harbor_adapters resolve on the host; cmd/bench/matrix.go:1014-1026 (harborAgentArgs) hardwires --agent-import-path scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.<x>; the only harness IO contract today is Python under scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/{fiz,opencode,pi,cost_probe,noop,dumb_script}.py with harbor classes at scripts/benchmark/harbor_agent.py:83 (FizeauAgent) and scripts/benchmark/harbor_adapters/{claude.py:31,codex.py:32,opencode.py:64,pi.py:68}.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/Dockerfile.harbor-runner: FROM python:3.12-slim; pip install --no-cache-dir harbor-bench==<pinned> (5-min spike: confirm pip vs pip install git+https://github.com/laude-institute/...); COPY harbor_adapters/ and harbor_agent.py into /app; ENV PYTHONPATH=/app; WORKDIR /app; ENTRYPOINT ["harbor"].
- scripts/benchmark/build-harbor-runner.sh: docker build with --label image-content-sha=<sha256 of harbor_adapters/ + harbor_agent.py + Dockerfile.harbor-runner> (build-harbor-runner.sh:21-36 prototypes the hash); ./benchmark preflight rebuilds when cached label != current sha.
- scripts/benchmark/task-executors/harbor: bash wrapper; docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$cell_dir:/output" -v "$tasks_dir:/tasks:ro" -e FIZEAU_API_KEY -e FIZEAU_BASE_URL -e FIZEAU_MODEL fizeau-harbor-runner:latest run --agent-import-path "$harbor_plugin" --task-id "$task_id" --output /output; reads task-spec.json on stdin; writes cell_dir/result.json; records task_executor_version + harbor_runner_image_digest into <out>/sweep.json (runner copies into each cell).
- scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/{fiz,claude,codex,opencode,pi,cost-probe,noop,dumb-script}: each executable with a '# SUMMARY:' header and two subcommands: install <agent-artifact-path> -> install-spec.json {install_command, artifact_source, binary_path, harbor_plugin}; command (profile JSON on stdin) -> command-spec.json {command, env, secret_env_keys}. claude/codex emit harbor_plugin scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.{claude:ClaudeAgent,codex:CodexAgent}; fiz emits scripts.benchmark.harbor_agent:FizeauAgent. Python harness_adapters/*.py are the reference for emitted shapes.
- scripts/benchmark/runtime-probe.sh: case on profile.metadata.runtime -> curl + jq each backend (lucebox, llamacpp, vllm, omlx, ds4, rapid-mlx, one arm each) -> model_server JSON {name,version,commit,endpoint}.
- scripts/benchmark/{task-executors,harness-adapters}/CONTRACT.md document the JSON shapes and the '# SUMMARY:' convention.

NON-SCOPE: runner dispatch/--plan/matrix expansion (A2); per-cell execution loop, resume/retry, report compose (A3); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); Go changes, deactivation, parity (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor bench-set schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: parent fizeau-163efede. Foundation bead — no sibling deps; A2/A3/A5 depend on this. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. ./benchmark harness-adapters and ./benchmark task-executors list every adapter with its '# SUMMARY:' line. Test: Test_AdapterListing (scripts/benchmark/tests/adapters.bats).
2. echo <profile.json> | harness-adapters/fiz command emits command-spec.json matching harness_adapters/fiz.py; harness-adapters/<x> install emits install-spec.json with the correct harbor_plugin for all 8. Test: Test_AdapterContract_fiz, Test_AdapterContract_claude, Test_AdapterContract_codex (adapters.bats); TestHarborAgentInstall (scripts/benchmark/test_harbor_agent.py).
3. build-harbor-runner.sh builds fizeau-harbor-runner:latest with an image-content-sha label equal to sha256 of harbor_adapters/+harbor_agent.py+Dockerfile.harbor-runner; a re-run with no source change is a cache hit (label unchanged). Test: Test_BuildLabelMatchesContentSha (scripts/benchmark/tests/build_label.bats).
4. runtime-probe.sh emits model_server JSON for each of the 6 backends from a captured fixture. Test: Test_RuntimeProbe_lucebox, Test_RuntimeProbe_vllm (scripts/benchmark/tests/runtime_probe.bats).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: Adapters/image/runtime-probe ACs 1-4 pass; go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
